hooks.name: Sync Concepts to ChatApp
hooks.description: When agent-discovery/concepts.py or default_concepts.json is edited, automatically copy it to chatapp/app/shared/ to keep the shared vocabulary in sync for Docker builds.

action.command: cp agent-discovery/concepts.py chatapp/app/shared/concepts.py && cp agent-discovery/default_concepts.json chatapp/app/shared/default_concepts.json
